articles.title: Essendon outline plan for James Hird after opting for Mark McVeigh as head coach
articles.summary: Hird can bring ‘significant value’ to club, says Bombers president. McVeigh takes on head coach role after leaving Sydney Swans. Essendon president Andrew Welsh and new coach Mark McVeigh have offered an olive branch to James Hird, declaring they intend to speak with the club great about a role at…
body: McVeigh was appointed Essendon coach on Monday, with the club opting for the Sydney Swans assistant ahead of fellow former Bombers player Hird, Fremantle’s Jaymie Graham and Adelaide’s Murray Davis.
Hird, who quit as Essendon coach in 2015 after a tenure marred by the club’s supplements saga, had pitched for the top job.
“I feel there is significant value James can bring,” Welsh said of Hird on Tuesday. “Not just tokenistic, but real value James can bring to our club and playing group.”

Hird didn’t answer Welsh’s calls, and the Essendon president sent him a text and hoped to speak with his former teammate on Tuesday. Hird was an assistant to McVeigh when he was interim GWS senior coach in 2022.

articles.title: 'Change is necessary' - players unite against Fifa
articles.summary: A number of current and former footballers unite against Fifa president Gianni Infantino, stating that "change is necessary" at the global governing body.
body: A number of current and former footballers have united against under-pressure Fifa president Gianni Infantino, stating "change is necessary" at the head of the global governing body.
Former Manchester United and France defender Mikael Silvestre, who sits on Fifa's Players' Voice Panel, issued a statement on X, external on Monday in a post he titled "Enough is Enough!".
The statement has been shared on social media by the likes of England defender Lucy Bronze, France's 1998 World Cup winner Emmanuel Petit, and former England goalkeeper David James.

It follows Infantino's controversial plan to sell stakes in competitions, including the World Cup, to private investors, with the statement saying players "share the exact same concerns as the millions of fans around the world".

articles.title: The Olympic champion re-building her body in a bid for LA 2028
articles.summary: Imogen Grant's event, lightweight rowing has been removed from the Olympic calendar. Instead of making weight, now she has to gain it to compete.
body: When British rower Imogen Grant won Olympic gold in Paris, it could easily have been the final race of her career.
Lightweight rowing, the discipline in which she had enjoyed her greatest success, was disappearing from the Olympic calendar. Within days she was back at work as a doctor.
But once her race was over, Grant had a chance to experience the rest of the Paris Games, and something shifted.
"It's so special. I just have to try and do it again," she remembers thinking.

articles.title: Glaring weakness in goal remains but early signs Xabi Alonso’s Chelsea should be fun | Jonathan Wilson
articles.summary: The failure to replace Robert Sánchez remains a mystery but the new-look front three should buy time for the new manager’s principles to bed in. After a weekend on which pretty much every potential challenger to Arsenal had demonstrated their flaws, there was a sense, perhaps even a need, for…
body: They looked extremely dangerous in the final third, and Cole Palmer was involved in all three Chelsea goals, perhaps benefiting from a first summer off in three years. But they were rather less impressive through midfield or at the back, despite Josh Acheampong’s all-action performance, while goalkeeper remains the problem it has been since Thibaut Courtois left.

It could easily have gone wrong: in the final quarter-hour; Antonee Robinson lofted an effort wide with Robert Sánchez off his line and Ryan Sessegnon smacked a shot from a narrow angle straight at the Spanish keeper. But neither opportunity was taken and so Chelsea got Xabi Alonso’s reign off to a winning start.

At this stage, performances and learning the system are probably the most important thing, but if there is to be some sort of dart at the title, results matter if only to keep Chelsea somewhere near the race until the point at which Alonso’s principles are absorbed and they do find something close to top form.

articles.title: Campaigning for cancer screening should not be down to me - Hoy
articles.summary: The cycling legend tells BBC Scotland that the onus to encourage men to get tested for prostate cancer should not just be on high profile individuals like him.
body: Sir Chris Hoy believes the onus to encourage men to get tested for prostate cancer should not just be on high-profile individuals like him.
Hoy told BBC Scotland he felt privileged to have the public platform to spread awareness and would continue to do so even if there was a national screening system in place.
But he said: "It shouldn't just be down to high-profile individuals like Jeremy Clarkson or myself or any number of men who've been in a similar situation.
"There should be a more systematic and proactive approach to let men know about their own risk."

articles.title: FC Barcelona Star Balde Makes Decision On Future At Club
articles.summary: FC Barcelona left back Alejandro Balde has decided that he wants to leave his boyhood club according to MARCA, which cited anonymous sources. Balde is now pushing for a loan out for the 2026/2027 season, though Barca reportedly wants a sale with a week remaining until the transfer window closes.
body: The defender has often been linked with a potential move away from the Spotify Camp Nou because of constant interest from the Premier League.
In the last 10 days or so, though, his life in the Catalan capital, where was born and raised, has been turned upside down.
First came the permanent free transfer of Joao Cancelo, who last season dislodged Balde from Hansi Flick’s starting XI.
Then on Saturday, Flick made comments at his prematch press conference ahead of Elche that seemed to suggest Balde’s commitment has been an issue.

articles.title: Nottingham Forest close in on signing Liam Delap from Chelsea
articles.summary: Oliver Glasner wants two more buys in transfer window. Aston Villa target Club Brugge defender Joel Ordóñez. Nottingham Forest are in advanced talks with Chelsea over a deal for Liam Delap. Oliver Glasner wants two more signings before the transfer window closes a week on Tuesday.
body: Delap, who was on Forest’s radar when the striker opted to join Chelsea from Ipswich, is out of favour at Stamford Bridge and has been training away from Xabi Alonso’s first team. The 23-year-old was left out of Chelsea’s squad for their game at Fulham on Monday.

Glasner, who has implemented a three-man defence at Forest, is also keen to strengthen at wing-back. “The club is working very hard to get these deals done,” the Austrian head coach said. “I’m very confident that we will get in two more high-quality players.”

Forest have signed Ousmane Diomande, Xaver Schlager and Steven Benda this summer, paying a fee only for the former. Diomande joined in a £34m deal from Sporting. Forest host Leeds in the Carabao Cup second round on Tuesday, a rematch of their Premier League defeat last Saturday. Morgan Gibbs-White will miss the game because of a knee problem but Forest hope he will available for the trip to Liverpool on Saturday.

articles.title: Rennes interested in Martin Terrier loan
articles.summary: Stade Rennais remain interested in Bayer Leverkusen forward Martin Terrier (29), as per a report from Foot Mercato. The Frenchman left the Breton club two years ago to move to the Bundesliga, however, injuries have prevented him from flourishing in Germany.
body: In two seasons at Bayer Leverkusen, Terrier has been limited to just 44 appearances. In that time, he has netted seven goals. He has been less successful there than he was at Roazhon Park. With Rennes, Terrier scored 51 goals and registered 24 assists in 141 games in all competitions. A return to Brittany could now be on the cards.

Rennes have strengthened in attack with the signing of Eliezer Mayenda, whilst the club have also so far succeeded in retaining Esteban Lepaul. However, Breel Embolo has left, joining Atlanta United in the MLS on a permanent deal. Adding a forward is, therefore, on Rennes’ to-do list and they could add Terrier on a loan deal.

articles.title: Blow as Juventus may have lost Kenan Yildiz for a long time
articles.summary: Juventus have been handed a major fitness blow after it was revealed that Kenan Yildiz has suffered an injury that could keep him out of action for several months. Yildiz did not finish the match against Frosinone at the weekend, but most fans believed the decision to take him off was tactical.
body: More tests will be conducted on the attacker, but the initial diagnosis is not positive. Goal says Yildiz could miss more than two months of action, leaving Juventus facing a significant setback at the start of the season.

The injury comes at a difficult time for the Bianconeri, who want to make a strong start to the campaign. Juventus were among the top teams in the division after the opening week, but they will now have to cope without arguably their best and most reliable attacker.

Yildiz’s importance to the team was evident during the final weeks of last season when he was previously unavailable. His absence was reflected in Juventus’ results, and it was one of the reasons the Bianconeri surprisingly dropped points and failed to secure a place in the top four.

That experience will make the latest injury particularly concerning for Juventus. They know how difficult it can be to maintain their level without Yildiz, and his potential absence for more than two months could create another major challenge for the team.

articles.title: Chelsea’s front three dazzle as they edge out Fulham in derby thriller
articles.summary: Perhaps there will come a time when Xabi Alonso has taught Chelsea how to master the art of game management. This is a team still to learn how to grind. Equally it is a team capable of hurting anyone, and although Alonso’s first outing as Chelsea’s manager featured plenty of terrible defending it…
body: No wonder Maxence Lacroix wanted to join in the fun. The £52m centre‑back marked his debut with a thrilling assist, storming forward to make Rogers’s first goal since his £117m move from Aston Villa. João Pedro was no less effective as the No 9, while the biggest positive for Alonso had to be Palmer looking rested, dangerous and determined to prove a point after his injury woes last season led to him being left out of England’s World Cup squad.

Keep playing this well and Thomas Tuchel will surely name Palmer alongside Rogers for the Nations League games next month. Chelsea’s two No 10s both got to do the “ice cold” celebration and their combinations with João Pedro should have been enough to ensure this 3-2 win against Fulham was less stressful.

There were reminders that Chelsea have much to improve if they want to challenge for the title. Their defending left much to be desired, even with the towering Lacroix in the middle of the back three, and Robert Sánchez’s feeble attempt to stop Josh King from scoring Fulham’s first goal bolsters the argument that Chelsea need a new No 1.

articles.title: Leeds and Rangers co-owner York arrested
articles.summary: Leeds United and Rangers co-owner Jed York was arrested over the weekend in Ohio and pleaded no contest to misdemeanour charges of disorderly conduct and possessing criminal tools.
body: Court records show that York, who owns the San Francisco 49ers, was initially charged with engaging in prostitution, but prosecutors amended that to disorderly conduct.
York was arrested Sunday morning at a mobile home community in East Palestine, Ohio, near where he was born and raised in Youngstown. He was released after posting a $5,000 bond.
He was sentenced to one day in jail for both offences to be served concurrently and was credited with one day served when he pleaded no contest Monday morning. He was also fined $1,150.

Records also show that York had his cell phone returned to him and that $160 that was seized was to be given to the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force as part of the plea agreement. York also completed an online course.

articles.title: Cameron: It will take someone special to beat me - Mayer's not that
articles.summary: Chantelle Cameron is aiming for a career-best performance when she takes on Mikaela Mayer in their blockbuster main event unification bout in Birmingham on Saturday.
body: British world champion Cameron (22-1, 8 KOs) faces American Mayer (22-2, 5 KOs) at the bp pulse LIVE arena in Birmingham on August 29 - live on Sky Sports - with every bout on the MVPW-06 main card pitting a UK fighter against a US opponent.
Cameron maintains Mayer - who holds the WBC and WBA belts - is not "special" enough to threaten her chances of victory.
"I really do believe this is going to be a great performance by me - I think it's going to be my best performance of my career, I really do," Cameron told Sky Sports.

"I feel like everything's gone well and there's no reason for it to fall apart on fight night. When I'm like this, and I've put the work in and my mindset is where I want it to be, nobody's beating me.

articles.title: Cal Raleigh Hits Career-High 3 Homers For Mariners Amid Season-Long Slump
articles.summary: Cal Raleigh busted out of a season-long slump with the first three-homer game of his career Monday night. The switch-hitting catcher capped a five-run first inning with a two-run shot off struggling Philadelphia Phillies ace Zack Wheeler.
body: Raleigh added a leadoff homer against Wheeler in the fifth and a solo drive off reliever Chase Shugart in the seventh to give him 17 home runs this season.
It was the first multihomer game of the year for Raleigh, who finished 3 for 3 with a walk in a 9-2 victory and raised his batting average from.159 to.167.
Raleigh was runner-up for the AL MVP award last year, when he led the majors with 60 home runs and added 125 RBIs.
